rate_path.rationale: The Committee held the rate at 0 to 1/4 percent and emphasized that economic conditions would warrant exceptionally low rates through mid-2013, with a few members suggesting additional accommodation. This reflects a balanced stance with a slight lean toward easing, consistent with a dovish bias on the rate path.
